fusions.name: Aerial Snatch
fusions.desc: Snatches a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lifted Venom
fusions.desc: Strikes an afflicted enemy for 9 damage and uses up one of your afflictions on it. It needs an affliction on the target.

fusions.name: Branch Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nimble Takings
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
